web-guide-idea-102.audience: People curious about ordinary life in a mountain town.
web-guide-idea-102.offer: Share the everyday side of a place usually shown as a holiday backdrop. Breakfast, weather and household tasks can create a distinctive live diary.
web-guide-idea-102.steps.1: Talk through the day’s routine and a local detail.
web-guide-idea-102.steps.2: Pause for questions and end before moving somewhere with poor coverage.
web-guide-idea-102.equipment: A phone, charger and weather-appropriate setup. A stationary window view can be enough.
web-guide-idea-102.returnReason: Let viewers follow changing weather and recurring routines over time.
web-guide-idea-102.promotion: Preview one ordinary moment rather than promising a dramatic adventure every day.
web-guide-idea-102.metadataTitle: Pahadon Mein Mera Din — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-102.metadataDescription: Share the ordinary moments of living in a mountain town, from breakfast to evening views. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
